name: mateu-ui
description: Renders a Mateu screen (a model-driven UI served by a Mateu backend) inside this page, with the page's own JET runtime and Redwood theme.

baseUrl.description: The URL of the Mateu UI mount: its API is <baseUrl>/mateu/v3/... (e.g. https://erp.acme.com/mateu). Empty = the same origin as this page.

route.description: The Mateu route to open, relative to the mount (e.g. orders or orders/:id). Empty = the home of the app. Written back when the screen navigates inside the component (bind it with {{ }} to follow it).

params.description: Fills the :placeholders of the route; the rest travel as the query (a listing opens filtered by them).

initialState.description: The component state the first load of the screen is sent with (a form opens pre-filled).

appContext.description: The app state (@AppContext values: the active company, hotel, fiscal year…) sent with every request. Changing it reloads the screen.

token.description: Sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> on every request (a value with its own scheme, 'Basic …', is sent as is).

headers.description: Extra headers for every request to the Mateu backend (tenant, correlation id…).

headersProvider.description: function(url) returning the headers (or a Promise of them), called on EVERY request: the way to pass a token that rotates. Wins over token/headers.

withCredentials.description: Sends the browser's cookies to a backend on another origin (fetch credentials: 'include'; the backend must allow credentials for this origin).

navigation.description: internal: navigations the screen asks for happen inside the component (mateu-navigate is fired first and can be cancelled); host: they never happen inside — the page reacts to mateu-navigate.

mateuNavigate.description: The screen asks for another route. detail: {route, force}. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the component where it is (navigation=internal).

mateuAction.description: The user ran a Mateu action on the screen. detail: {actionId, parameters}.

mateuTitle.description: The screen's title changed (the page title belongs to the host: the component reports it). detail: {title}.

mateuMessage.description: A message for the user (it is also shown inside the component). detail: {summary, message, type, displayMode}.

mateuReady.description: The first screen is painted. detail: {route}.

mateuError.description: A request or a step failed. detail: {kind, message, status} or {chain, message}.

navigate.description: Opens a route inside the component (as setting route + params would).
